issue.title: Bug: incorrect break indent in macsec dut selection

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

- current logic is not selecting macsec capabale dut due to incorrect break indent
Ref: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/tests/conftest.py#L628

### Steps to Reproduce

- Try to run sonic-mgmt tests with modular duts on T2 topology
- If the first line card is not macsec capable,  "macsec_duthost" returns None, resulting into test failures.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

- "macsec_duthost" should find macsec capabale linecard to run macsec sonic-mgmt tests
